headline: One picture, 529 different works
reasons: The same picture was saved as 3 different files and attached to 529 different works in 5 villages. A photo of one site cannot be evidence for 529 separate works.

The 3 files hold one picture saved more than once (for example re-compressed, resized, cut by a few pixels or with another date or GPS stamp printed on it), so their bytes differ. They were matched by comparing the pictures: every two of these files differ in at most 0 of 256 bits of a picture fingerprint (the limit is 8), and their small greyscale copies differ by at most 0.001 (the limit is 0.03).
The files (first 12 characters of each fingerprint): 3611a6054a3f on 418 works, cec2223db41d on 109 works, 31291194e026 on 2 works.
The works are recorded as: Other (523), Bore-Well Recharge (5), Contour Trench (1).
These works are spread over 2 blocks: Balod, Dondi.
